title: Let the structured plan own its generated tasks
when: When a selected workflow needs real task decomposition or its planned task graph changes.
need: Distinguish the parent item from generated tasks, persisted task scope, dispatch order, review and integration simulation; do not replace these with invented child items. Local dispatch readiness requires tasks and chains, while GitHub task issues are optional; retry through the registered sync entrypoint and preserve ownership, lane assignments and queue progress.
surface: Shepherd/Conduct/Amend/Simulate skills; workflow-item and epic-task operations
gap: Workflow-kind choice is mapped; post-planning amendment and integration-gap discovery are not. Review question: should the human see this depth only when their work actually requires multiple lanes or an amendment?
